chapter_seo_title: Mortal Stream Economics: The Value of a Useless Treasure Fragment
chapter_meta_description: Han Li navigates a frantic market of desperate cultivators. When a Magical Treasure Fragment appears, a fierce argument reveals the cold, harsh economics of the cultivation world. A lesson in utility vs. rarity.
og_description: Han Li listens, learns, and watches a brutal negotiation over a useless treasure.
twitter_title: The Great Southern Assembly's Final Day
twitter_description: In a world of cultivators, the value of a treasure is only what you can use it for.
